context: Representative front-matter cleanup: add parsing behavior while moving repeated Optional value reads into a helper/Optional boundary.

checklist.name: Uses Optional map boundary
checklist.description: Uses frontMatter.flatMap/map plus a parsing helper or equivalent direct Optional boundary instead of guarding then reading frontMatter.get().

checklist.name: Removes Optional reopening
checklist.description: Does not keep frontMatter.get() or frontMatter.orElseThrow() after an isPresent()/isEmpty() guard.

checklist.name: Avoids null/list workaround
checklist.description: Does not use orElse(null), local null branching, Optional.stream().toList(), or a loop over one Optional.

checklist.name: Adds String support
checklist.description: Returns Optional.of(parsed) for trimmed numeric String values.

checklist.name: Handles empty and malformed values
checklist.description: Returns Optional.empty() for absent front matter, missing key, blank string, malformed string, and unsupported types without throwing.
